      1. Free account

      Enable your agents to unlock knowledge from anywhere

      Foundry IQ (Azure AI Search) provides a context engineering platform for Microsoft's intelligence layer, unlocking knowledge for your agents, wherever it lives. Foundry IQ automatically handles how agents connect to, process and action enterprise information. With built-in enterprise security and agentic retrieval, agents deliver better results from the right context. Foundry IQ knowledge bases require a subscription and a standard agentic retrieval plan. Foundry IQ agentic retrieval activity is billed under "Azure AI Search".

      Explore pricing options

      Apply filters to customize pricing options for your needs. “N/A” indicates pricing is not supported in the selected region.

      Prices are estimates only and are not intended as actual price quotes. Actual pricing may vary depending on the type of agreement entered with Microsoft, date of purchase, and the currency exchange rate. Prices are calculated based on US dollars and converted using London closing spot rates that are captured in the two business days prior to the last business day of the previous month end. If the two business days prior to the end of the month fall on a bank holiday in major markets, the rate setting day is generally the day immediately preceding the two business days. This rate applies to all transactions during the upcoming month. Sign in to the Azure pricing calculator to see pricing based on your current program/offer with Microsoft. Contact an Azure sales specialist for more information on pricing or to request a price quote. See frequently asked questions about Azure pricing.

      Serverless (preview)

      Serverless pricing is for workloads with infrequent or variable traffic. You are billed for compute resources and storage used, and the service scales to zero when idle. No upfront capacity planning is required.

      Billing for Serverless is expected to begin in late 2026 with details provided at least 30-days in advance. Customers using Serverless won’t be charged before billing is enabled.

      * What is a Compute Unit (CU)?

      A Compute Unit (CU) is the unit of measure for resource consumption in a serverless tier. Usage is billed in Compute Unit-Hour. Usage is calculated each minute in increments of 0.25 CUs.

      What 1 CU Represents

      ~1 vCPU core

      + 8 GB RAM

      + associated storage I/O

      What Gets Billed

      Compute consumed by your operations over the course of an hour​.

      Usage is calculated each minute in increments of 0.25 CUs

      Operations Included

      Searches, indexing, indexer execution, agentic retrieval & other service ops

      Read more about Compute Units (CU) and pricing Learn More

      Indexed storage

      Storage costs are billed hourly based on a fractional number of GBs of data stored per index. Total storage consumed includes all data stored in your indexes, such as indexed documents, searchable fields, vector data, and associated metadata within your search service.

      To learn more about Serverless and Compute Units, visit our docs.

      Features

      Agentic retrieval uses a multi-turn, self-reflective agentic framework to run and manage RAG query pipelines. Separate charges are incurred for remote knowledge sources Microsoft SharePoint (remote) and Web.

      Semantic ranker improves search relevance for single-turn retrieval query pipelines and keyword search. It is not available in the Dedicated Free tier.

      Custom entity Lookup skill detects and labels documents containing user-defined words and phrases. It is ideal for defining and detecting specific entities in your data. It is not available in dedicated free plan.

      Document cracking and image extraction retrieves content from a file during an indexer's document cracking phase and within the enrichment pipeline. Image extraction is billed during the initial document cracking step and when invoking the document extraction skill.

## Enable your agents to unlock knowledge from anywhere

Foundry IQ (Azure AI Search) provides a context engineering platform for Microsoft's intelligence layer, unlocking knowledge for your agents, wherever it lives. Foundry IQ automatically handles how agents connect to, process and action enterprise information. With built-in enterprise security and agentic retrieval, agents deliver better results from the right context.
Foundry IQ knowledge bases require a subscription and a standard agentic retrieval plan. Foundry IQ agentic retrieval activity is billed under "Azure AI Search".

This rate applies to all transactions during the upcoming month. ### Serverless (preview)

Serverless pricing is for workloads with infrequent or variable traffic. You are billed for compute resources and storage used, and the service scales to zero when idle. No upfront capacity planning is required.

Billing for Serverless is expected to begin in late 2026 with details provided at least 30-days in advance. Customers using Serverless won’t be charged before billing is enabled.

For large-scale Serverless deployments,  [contact Microsoft](https://aka.ms/FoundryIQ-serverless-contact) for additional options.

#### \* What is a Compute Unit (CU)?

A Compute Unit (CU) is the unit of measure for resource consumption in a serverless tier. Usage is billed in Compute Unit-Hour. Usage is calculated each minute in increments of 0.25 CUs.

##### What 1 CU Represents

**~1 vCPU core**

**+ 8 GB RAM**

+ associated storage I/O

##### What Gets Billed

Compute consumed by your operations over the course of an hour​.

Usage is calculated each minute in increments of 0.25 CUs

##### Operations Included

Searches, indexing, indexer execution, agentic retrieval & other service ops

Read more about Compute Units (CU) and pricing  [Learn More](https://aka.ms/c-u)

#### Indexed storage

Storage costs are billed hourly based on a fractional number of GBs of data stored per index. Total storage consumed includes all data stored in your indexes, such as indexed documents, searchable fields, vector data, and associated metadata within your search service.

*To learn more about Serverless and Compute Units, [visit our docs](https://aka.ms/c-u).*

### Features

**Agentic retrieval** uses a multi-turn, [self-reflective agentic framework](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/search/agentic-retrieval-overview?tabs=quickstarts#availability-and-pricing) to run and manage RAG query pipelines. **Separate** charges are incurred for remote knowledge sources Microsoft SharePoint (remote) and [Web](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/bing/apis/grounding-pricing).

**Semantic ranker** improves [search relevance](https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/search/semantic-search-overview) for single-turn retrieval query pipelines and keyword search. It is not available in the Dedicated Free tier.

**Custom entity Lookup skill** detects and labels documents containing user-defined words and phrases. It is ideal for defining and detecting specific entities in your data. It is not available in dedicated free plan.

**Document cracking and image extraction** [retrieves content](https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/search/semantic-search-overview) from a file during an indexer's document cracking phase and within the enrichment pipeline. Image extraction is billed during the initial document cracking step and when invoking the document extraction skill.

## Frequently asked questions

[Frequently asked questions about Azure pricing](/en-us/pricing/)

* What are the differences between the Foundry IQ (Azure AI Search) tiers?

  Foundry IQ (Azure AI Search) offers capacity-based tiers with predictable pricing and usage-based tiers with scale to zero pricing. Refer to our [documentation](docs:search/search-sku-tier) for more details on the different tiers and guidance for selecting which plan is right for you.
* How do I create an Azure AI Search account?

  Azure AI Search is available in the new [Microsoft Azure portal](https://portal.azure.com). First, you must sign up for an Azure subscription, then you can add an Azure AI Search account to your Azure subscription via the gallery in the preview portal. [Get more information](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/search/search-manage).
* What is the difference between agentic retrieval and semantic ranker?

  Agentic retrieval autonomously decides the best sources and methods for retrieving information, enhancing response quality through reasoning and planning. Semantic ranker improves search relevance by understanding and leveraging the semantics of user queries. Learn more [here](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/search/semantic-search-overview).
